prompt: Rewrite a speaker bio that labels qualities (passionate, resilient, committed) rather than showing them through specific actions

assertions.name: Removes generic quality labels
assertions.description: Output should not contain 'passionate', 'resilience', 'deeply committed', 'tremendous adversity', 'significant impact' as standalone claims

assertions.name: Shows a specific action or behavior
assertions.description: Output should contain at least one concrete action that demonstrates a quality rather than naming it

assertions.name: Uses defensible credential numbers
assertions.description: If credentials are stated, they should match verified figures: 1,000+ trained, $10M+ revenue impact — not inflated or invented numbers
